title: Endovenous Ablation Therapy for Varicose Veins of Lower Extremity
jurisdiction: CMS Hospital Outpatient Prior Authorization (42 CFR § 419.80)
description: CMS prior authorization for endovenous radiofrequency or laser ablation of incompetent saphenous veins. Requires duplex ultrasound demonstrating retrograde reflux >= 500 ms, symptomatic venous insufficiency interfering with daily activities, and failure of at least 3 months of trial of graduated medical compression stockings (20-30 mmHg).

criteria.name: Venous Reflux Duration (>= 500 ms on Duplex Ultrasound)
criteria.description: Duplex ultrasound examination showing retrograde flow/reflux duration >= 500 milliseconds in the great saphenous vein, small saphenous vein, or accessory saphenous vein.
criteria.clinical_intent: Objective hemodynamic validation of saphenous insufficiency
criteria.cms_document: CMS OPD Prior Authorization Program Guide

criteria.name: Graduated Compression Stocking Trial (>= 3 Months)
criteria.description: Documented trial of graduated medical compression therapy (at least 20-30 mmHg) for >= 3 months (90 days) with persistent pain, edema, or stasis dermatitis.
criteria.cms_document: CMS OPD Prior Authorization Program Guide

criteria.name: Asymptomatic Spider Vein Telangiectasia Exclusion
criteria.description: Treatment of asymptomatic spider veins or telangiectasias without saphenous reflux or functional impairment.
criteria.cms_document: CMS OPD Prior Authorization Program Guide
